Odds calculator#1:
def to_chance(odds):
    return round(-odds / (-odds + 100), 4) if odds < 0 else round(100 / (odds + 100), 4)
Odds calculator#2:
def book_cut(a, b):
    return round((to_chance(a) + to_chance(b) - 1) * 100, 1)
Odds calculator#3:
def to_odds(chance):
    return round(-100 * chance / (1 - chance)) if chance >= 0.5 else round(100 * (1 - chance) / chance)
